title: New meaning leaves an answer lightness

captions.physics: Answering anew a request for clarity
captions.emotions: Feeling lightness in an unfamiliar remark

meaning: You can answer a request for understandable words anew and keep gentle courage through clarification, feeling lightness in an unfamiliar reply without constantly speaking playfully.
text: On your Vishuddha, Judgement in the physical position appears in another answer to a request for understandable words heard differently. Strength in energy supports gentle courage in clarification without humiliating someone for not understanding. The Fool in emotions brings lightness in an unfamiliar remark. You can hear the request differently and try another way to speak. A new beginning requires neither denying a thought’s complexity nor immediately finding a perfect explanation.

For example, you return to “Why not say it more simply?” Previously heard as judging your ability to speak, it now reveals a request to explain one expression. **An understood request gives an answer a free beginning**. Ordinary words can describe meaning without self-humiliation or mocking the question. Lightness emerges because the former formulation need not be defended as uniquely correct. Yet another reply need be neither funny nor unusual. A simple explanation remains genuine even if further thought still needs time.

Difficulty arises if this lightness is demanded of every difficult explanation. Gentle courage becomes an obligation always to make complexity pleasant and quick. Constructive Strength helps preserve care alongside honest unreadiness. You can speak more simply and directly name today’s explanatory limit; freshness is not measured by wit, while a clear question requires neither abandoning every detail nor proving every misunderstanding will now disappear easily from the first remark.
